selection: Public long monitoring and resolved images, chosen before model fitting or withheld magnitude inspection; selection does not depend on prediction success.

split.boundary_source: Last epoch of the independent earlier Bonvin13year release
split.reduction_caveat: Retrospective chronological test within one2020common reduction; not a prospectively blinded acquisition. Older release is re-reduced and not concatenated.

primary_test.conditioning: all training points plus later image B as an explicitly allowed observed driver
primary_test.estimand: frozen cross-image conditional predictive density and marginal calibration, conditional on fitted parameters

secondary_test.estimand: joint future-light covariance/brightness forecast, not deterministic prediction of unknown quasar fluctuations

likelihood.formula: m_i(t)=m0+b_i+q(t-d_i)+e_i(t)+noise_i; q shared stationary OU, e_i independent slow OU, b_i proper Gaussian offset; quoted error plus fitted jitter
likelihood.interpretation: Classical empirical optical-brightness likelihood; not the BHSM quantum statistical state, Wick closure or a preparation kernel.
likelihood.magnitude_zero: pooled median of training magnitudes only
likelihood.optimizer: boundedL-BFGS-B, maximum200iterations per start; highest training likelihood selected
likelihood.uncertainty: Point-fit conditional predictive intervals; no claim of fully marginalized physical state or calibrated parameter confidence.

macro_models.data: Published HST relative point-image/galaxy astrometry only, not a pixel-level Einstein-ring reconstruction; train-only delays from the above likelihood.
macro_models.density: Positive finite spherical Plummer body, regular localR1source; no arbitrary spherical scalar added to an elliptical density.
macro_models.propagation: One remote symmetric quadratic optical screen at fixed z_p=0.8, with its two-plane Jacobi maps and same source/clock; total optical tide is a conditional propagation input, not a reconstructed same-domain scalar environmental Hessian.
macro_models.background: Same declared frozenR1 FLRW H0=67.4 for both; recompute distances and local coefficients at z_l=.4546,z_s=1.693. This is a conditional reference geometry, not a fit proving cosmological viability.
macro_models.parameters: log10M in[10,13]; log10Plummera_kpc in[-.7,1.3]; source_angle x,y in[-.8,.8]arcsec; screen reduced convergence/shears each[-.4,.4]; mass center offset x,y Gaussian sigma.003arcsec bounded+/-.03arcsec.
macro_models.astrometry_errors: Published internal error plus explicitly prescribed2mas systematic in quadrature; diagonal relative-position covariance approximation because full covariance unavailable. A fixes observed coordinate origin.
models: fixed-stateR1 finitebodyresponse with training-only nuisance refit
complete matched conventional effective mass representation of theR1field (structural equality control)
macro_models.iteration: Any macro initialization/repair uses only training observations; no model-family selection from withheld score. Failed training fits are reported, not replaced by another lens.

controls: A zero-delay brightness-transfer control with the same frozen hyperparameters, reported as a control rather than selected by test performance.
freeze_rule: Freeze all fitted nuisance parameters and physical macro predictions, serialize hashes before any target scoring. Later-B conditioning is inference of the new driver realization without parameter refitting. No post-score tuning or retraining.
physical_scope: Conditional local quasi-static source and remote optical propagation model; no completed microscopicBHSMembedding or globalenvironmentalstate. Provisionaliteration is not physicaladmission;2e-10guard and originalcalibrationunchanged.
